tolerances.justification: MAR intersection points sit at centerline crossings; 25 m covers half the width of DC arterials plus centerline offsets. Bridge points are length-midpoints of the DDOT bridge line and must also fall inside a DCGIS bridge deck polygon; 15 m keeps the check on the structure, away from banks and parallel roads.

provider_road_match_note: Provider road match is a separate check (Xweather response metadata). Missing provider road metadata stays 'unresolved', never 'verified'.
